Name: Oops - Skill Based Mistakes and Progression
Author: acharles1
Description:
[center][b][size=4]OOPS![/size][/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][i]Grandpa gave you a farm.[/i][/center]
[center][i]He just forgot one tiny detail...[/i][/center]
[center][b]You have absolutely no idea what you're doing.[/b][/center]
[center][b]And now you own several acres of land.
Good luck.[/b][/center]

[b][size=4]Oops![/size][/b]
adds a lightweight skill-based mistake system to Stardew Valley where your farmer actually feels inexperienced when they first arrive in the valley. You'll miss swings, spill water, get nervous around monsters, react slowly when a fish finally bites, mishandle animal products and even accidentally upset your animals.

But don't worry.
The more experienced your farmer becomes, the better they get.


[size=3][b]NEWBIE TO PRO[/b][/size]
[size=2]Oops! follows your farmer’s permanent skill levels in:[/size]
[size=2][b]Farming • Mining • Foraging • Fishing • Combat[/b][/size]
[size=2]As your skills increase, mistakes become less frequent or less severe.[/size]
[size=2]At [b]Level 10[/b], you've mastered that skill, Farmer.[/size]


[b][size=3]FARM TOOLS[/size][/b]
[size=2]Using tools when you're inexperienced can sometimes go a little... wrong.[/size]
[size=2]Axe[/size]
[size=2]Sometimes you completely miss your target...[b]Oops.[/b][/size]
[size=2]Hoe[/size]
[size=2]Miss the ground you were trying to till... [b]Oops.[/b][/size]
[size=2]Watering Can[/size]
[size=2]Fumbled the watering?, better refill it... [b]Oops.[/b][/size]
[size=2]Pickaxe[/size]
[size=2]Mishandle the Pickaxe? OUCH!...  [b]Oops.[/b][/size]


[b][size=3]ANIMAL CARE[/size][/b]
[size=2]At low Farming levels, you can fumble an animal product badly enough to lose it and accidentally upset the animal in the process.[/size]
[size=2][b]“Oops, sorry [Animal Name]... I didn't mean to do that.”[/b][/size]


[size=3][b]FISHING[/b][/size]
[size=2]Oops! doesn't interfere with casting or the fishing minigame.[/size]
[size=2]Instead, the mistake happens at the worst possible moment.[/size]
[size=2]You cast.[/size]
[size=2]You wait.[/size]
[size=2]You finally see:[/size]
[size=2][b]![/b][/size]
[size=2]And then...[/size]
[size=2][b]Oops.[/b][/size]
[size=2]The fish gets away before the minigame even begins, your bobber stays in the water, and you have to wait for another bite.[/size]
[size=2]The better your Fishing skill becomes, the less often this happens.[/size]
[size=2]Fishing Level 10 removes the mistake entirely.[/size]


[size=3][b]COMBAT[/b][/size]
[size=2]Combat works a little differently.[/size]
[size=2]Your farmer isn't missing attacks or dealing random damage.[/size]
[size=2]They're simply [b]afraid[/b].[/size]
[size=2]When hostile monsters get close, inexperienced farmers become nervous and immediately forgets how legs work.[/size]
[size=2]As Combat improves, that fear disappears.[/size]
[size=2]Eventually it becomes confidence.[/size]
[table][tr][th][size=2]Combat Level[/size][/th]
[th][size=2]Effect[/size][/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=2][b]0–2[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=2]-2 Speed[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=2][b]3–4[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=2]-1 Speed[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=2][b]5–7[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=2]Normal movement[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=2][b]8–9[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=2]+1 Speed[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=2][b]10+[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=2]+2 Speed[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[/table][size=2]Only one Combat effect can exist at a time.[/size]
[size=2]Standing near ten monsters doesn't give you ten penalties.[/size]
[size=2]Once the danger is gone, the Oops! Combat effect disappears.[/size]


[size=3][b]OOPS COOLDOWN[/b][/size]
[size=2]After a Oops, you get a [b]2 in-game hour grace period[/b] before another one can happen.[/size]


[size=3][b]FORGIVING MISTAKES[/b][/size]
[size=2]Want the personality of Oops! without quite as much suffering?[/size]
[size=2]Enable:[/size]
[size=2][b]Forgiving Mistakes[/b][/size]
[size=2]This option is [b]OFF by default[/b].[/size]
[size=2]When enabled:[/size]
[size=2]- Bucket Drop still happens, but your watering can isn't emptied.[/size]

[size=2]- Early Animal Care mistakes still upset animals, but your product isn’t destroyed.[/size]


[b][size=3]🦆 WHY OOPS!?[/size][/b]
[size=2]I wanted skill levels to feel like more than numbers.
A brand-new farmer shouldn't necessarily feel identical to someone who has spent years farming, mining, fishing and fighting monsters.
Oops! adds that little period where your farmer is still figuring things out.
You make mistakes.
You waste some time.
You embarrass yourself.
Sometimes you hear a duck.
And slowly...
[b]you get better.[/b][/size]

[b][size=3]INSTALLATION[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=2]Install [b]SMAPI[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Download [b]Oops![/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Extract the [b]Oops![/b] folder into your Stardew Valley[/size]

[code]Mods[/code][size=2]folder[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Optional: install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] to change Oops! settings in-game[/size][/*]
[/list][size=2]That's it.[/size]
[size=2]No new save required.[/size]

Manifest.Name: Oops!
Manifest.Description: Adds skill-based newbie mistakes that fade with experience, now with less-predictable hidden Oops timing, full i18n support, and optional Forgiving Mistakes.
